_format: version = newest released launcher version, url = its download page/installer, notes = optional short changelog.
notes: Downloaded builds now have a red Delete button beside Start, with a confirmation before the managed build folder and its archive are removed. Every Item Shop card opens a draggable 360-degree cosmetic showcase with auto-spin, the shop itself now scrolls with up/down controls, and every available season shows its archive size in GB before download. Start now opens the selected downloaded build directly instead of handing off to Epic Games.
